item.title: [breach] Ericsson US confirms breach after third-party provider attack
item.description: Ericsson US reports a data breach after attackers hacked a service provider, exposing employee and customer information. Ericsson Inc., the U.S. branch of the Swedish telecom giant, disclosed a data breach after a service provider was hacked. The attack compromised the personal information of an unspecified number of employees and customers. &#8220;On April 28, 2025, [&#8230;]
